project.title: Somebody's Gotta Do It
project.energy: playful everyday absurdity escalating into aggressive, warehouse-ready club chaos

spoken.delivery: confident, mischievous, rhythmic, conversational; increasingly unhinged

sung.use_for_this_track: limited; optional pitched texture or chant layer only

production.bass: rubbery, syncopated, dirty, heavy, deliberately wonky
production.drums: club kick, sharp clap/snare, metallic/glitch percussion, fills and abrupt dropouts
production.arrangement_rule: keep the lyric phrasing intelligible; make the production progressively more chaotic
production.rights: original lyrics; use only original or appropriately licensed sound assets
production.direction: Keep the track's wonky bass-house groove and spoken-comedy personality, but raise the sound-design ambition with dubstep-influenced bass movement, heavier low-end impact, sharper transient design, dramatic tension, and memorable drop contrast. Do not turn it into a straight dubstep track.

bass_design: sub-bass fundamentals kept clean and centered
mid-bass call-and-response with the spoken lead
short fills, pitch dives, and rhythmic stutters
drop_design: hard-hitting kick and snare with controlled low-end
bass phrases that answer the vocal hook
half-time bridge with a heavier dubstep pocket before the final return
sound_quality: use high-quality original or appropriately licensed one-shots and synth sources
separate sub, mid-bass, drums, music and vocal buses
stereo width in upper layers while keeping sub mono
reference-check on headphones, car speakers and club/PA playback
dubstep_influences.mix_priority: Vocal intelligibility and kick/sub translation take priority over raw loudness

vocal_recording_plan.first_pass: record the full spoken lead from the cue sheet in one or more clean takes
next_passes: gang-shouted Somebody's gotta do it hook
pre-drop Is this too much? / Are we sure? / Fuck it. exchange
final chorus doubles and outro tag
vocal_recording_plan.capture: dry, close microphone, quiet room, no reverb or effects; effects are added non-destructively in the timeline

sections.name: intro_tag
sections.delivery: whispered repetitions; final line dry and up-front

sections.name: verse_1
sections.delivery: fast conversational spoken lead; sparse beat; ad-lib answers

sections.name: pre
sections.delivery: build urgency; overlapping voices; stop before drop

sections.name: chorus
sections.delivery: gang-shouted hook; hard rhythmic vocal chops

sections.name: verse_2
sections.delivery: spoken lead; denser bass and interruptions

sections.name: final_chorus_outro
sections.delivery: maximum layers; abrupt beat cut for final spoken tag

fx: short delay throws at phrase ends
alternating dry and distorted response voices
